item.title: On Friday morning, a woman was found under a train at Andrew Station.
item.description: There was a frightening scene at the Andrew Square MBTA station on Friday morning after a woman ended up underneath an inbound Red Line train. According to Transit Police, the incident happened around 10:14 a.m. when a 51-year-old woman deliberately entered the tracks as a train was pulling into the station.
